acquisition_routing.definition: Schematic stored-raster apertures; all enrolled group members. Clear: minimum detail >=0.30; smooth: minimum detail in [0.05,0.30). Both need >=96px, range>=0.10 and code-tail fractions<0.20. Engineering demonstration selected using three source-only development probes, not human recommendations.
acquisition_routing.claim: conditional on exchangeable whole groups under the frozen measured partition; not hidden-shift detection
acquisition_routing.not: not automated domain recognition; a matching label cannot detect hidden within-category shift
acquisition_routing.availability_limit: the rank theorem averages calibration/new-group randomness; selecting only finite delivered outputs does not acquire an extra conditional coverage guarantee
acquisition_routing.category_source: recomputed source pixels in all declared group apertures

localization_envelope.interpretation: conservative geometric gap bounds from calibrated reference ellipses; full covariance pushforward with fixed observed gauge; no extrapolation to unannotated vertices
localization_envelope.centering: reference ellipse centers are prediction minus development-only bias; displayed geometry remains raw

joint_error_geometry.set: one calibrated full16 ellipsoid per source; shared latent ball across all points
joint_error_geometry.relaxation: product of the SAME set's 8 marginal ellipses, SAME q; not a separately fitted model

relaxed_shape_distance.meaning: outer range of optimally proper-rotation-refitted RMS over admissible reference shapes, with their own uncertain eye spans
relaxed_shape_distance.not: not fixed observed-gauge displacement, not exact extrema, not a resemblance percentage

joint_error_geometry.statistical_status: no Gaussian assumption or independent landmark/source errors; no extra coverage from tighter algebra
joint_error_geometry.raw_repeatability_preserved: intrinsic_source_covariance remains the observed perturbation covariance

intrinsic_profile.quantile_meaning: legacy scalar exists only when both sources share a radius; source_quantiles is authoritative
intrinsic_profile.coverage_condition: only if both sources satisfy their frozen calibration assumptions; no new coverage from more relations
intrinsic_profile.gauge: intrinsic source relations; uncertain reference eye-span normalization, NOT a fixed observed pair alignment

limits: 2D projected geometry, not identity recognition or proof of 3D shape
model contours and interpolated fields derive from the same landmarks; not independent evidence
sensitivity intervals are conditional perturbation intervals, not measured localization-accuracy confidence intervals
flow consistency tests image matching, not anatomical correctness across people
within-tolerance fractions have an explicit threshold and denominator; they are not resemblance probabilities
no population rarity without an exact-recipe held-out reference cohort
the report contains new tool-side evidence, not inaccessible historical model activations
